name: Depaga ~Service Angel~
source:
Depaga are top class workers of huge department stores. But what's hidden from the eyes of buyers is lots of training. Main character must become an instructor of useless newcomer girls and make first class universal workers out of them to fill any role from waitresses to elevator girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
百货商场女店员是大型百货公司里的一流员工，但顾客看不见的是她们背后接受的大量训练。主人公必须担任无能新人少女们的教官，把她们培养成能够胜任从服务员到电梯小姐等任何岗位的一流全能员工。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
